fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. One 2-inch photo * 2. One copy of the first page of your passport, and also of one blank page of that. please ensure continuity 3. Certification of no criminal record * 4. HSK Certificate (for teaching program in Chinese). * 5. One copy of high school diploma Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Graduation certificate must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 6. One copy of high school notarized transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. Transcripts must be certified by the Chinese Embassy (Consulate) in your country or notarized by a notary office in China. * 7. Physical examination record for foreigner Physical examination record for foreigner You can download a template or sample from here . * 8. CSCA Test Transcript(s) -You need to take the official CSCA test organized by the Chinese government and submit the corresponding subject result transcript(s) when applying. Learn more about the CSCA test >> -The test covers Chinese (Humanities and STEM Chinese), Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. Mathematics is required for all programs, while other subjects depend on the university’s specific requirements. -We are updating detailed information for each university, including the required subjects you have to take for each program and their score requirements. Once the updates are ready, you can check the attachment and information here for this university for the latest information. If no attachment is available yet, it usually means the university has not announced further details. - Test Subjects: Professional Chinese, Mathematics. For applying for science or engineering majors, one of Physics and Chemistry should be selected for examination; Score line: Each subject are above 50 or the relative percentile ranking is within the top 60%. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Candidate must be under 25 years old, with a high school diploma or equivalent at least. 2. You need to have the certificate of HSK4 Chinese Proficiency Test with a score of 180(inclusive) or above. 3. CSCA Test Subjects: Professional Chinese(Applicants for Chinese-taught programs are required to provide), Mathematics. For applying for science or engineering majors, one of Physics and Chemistry should be selected for examination. 4. The scores of each subject in the China Scholastic Competency Assessment(CSCA) are above 35 or the relative percentile ranking is within the top 60%. * If your Chinese proficiency does not meet the requirements, you may first receive the Chinese language training for 1-2 years.
